verdict.rationale: Brex's docs show budgets/spend-limit tracking ('track spend instantly'), a transactions API for live account/transaction data, and a mobile app to 'view your spend' in real time, plus category/merchant-level expense data via expense management and audit agents. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of merchant-level real-time feed granularity, independent/hands-on confirmation that transactions post same-day rather than batched, and cross-team breakdowns beyond department/cost-center filters.
